values: Deals damage multiple times to the enemy.
辛巴达的所有技能同时也视为普通攻击，动作速度受到自身攻击速度与急速的共同影响。主动释放时，在3秒内尝试尽可能攻击对手，每次造成100% + 15% ATK伤害。结束后再次攻击目标造成240% ATK伤害。

Passive. Sinbad's skills also deal normal attack damage and his casting speed is affected by both his ATK SPD and Haste.
Active. Sinbad lands as many hits as possible on the enemy over the next 3s, dealing 100% + 15% ATK damage per hit. After these successive attacks, he delivers one final strike that deals 240% ATK damage.
每次造成的伤害提升至105% + 15% ATK,最后一击造成的伤害提升至250% ATK。

收集战场情报，对造成伤害最高以及承伤伤害最多的敌人进行针对性打击。
Sinbad assesses his enemies' strengths, focusing his attacks on the one dealing the most damage and the one taking the most damage.

战斗开始6秒后，辛巴达尝试朝己方阵营后方跳跃，落地后开始收集战场情报，找到截止目前累计造成伤害最高的敌人标记为“侵略者”，累计承受伤害最高的敌人标记为“守护者”，情报持续30秒。随后依次冲刺到目标面前进行特殊攻击，造成4次120% + 10% ATK伤害，并使得“侵略者”降低45%攻击力，使得“守护者”受到的伤害提升25%，持续至情报有效期结束。辛巴达在情报有效期结束或者场上同时不存在“侵略者”和“守护者”时再次收集情报，且在收集情报期间处于霸体状态。对首领类敌人的效果降低至原来的20%。

6s into a battle, Sinbad vaults behind his allies and starts assessing his enemies' strengths. He marks the enemy dealing the most damage as the "hitter" and the one taking the most damage as the "guard." These marks last for 30s. Sinbad then charges at the "hitter" and then the "guard", dealing 120% + 10% ATK damage to each target 4 times. The attack also reduces the "hitter's" ATK by 45% and increases the "guard's" damage taken by 25%. Both debuffs expire when their respective marks expire.
When a marked enemy is defeated or when the marks expire, Sinbad starts to assess his enemies again and becomes unaffected during this time. The debuffs are reduced to 20% of the original effect when used against Bosses.

提高情报分析的水平，进一步削弱“侵略者”和“守护者”。
Sinbad studies the fighting styles of the "hitter" and the "guard" to further weaken them in battle.
辛巴达提升自己的情报分析水平，分析“侵略者”造成伤害的主要方式，分析“守护者”对抗伤害的主要方式。若“侵略者”造成的伤害主要来源于其普通攻击，则辛巴达还会降低其60点攻击速度，反之则降低60%的回能效率。若“守护者”主要依靠友军或自身的治疗对抗敌人，则辛巴达会降低其60点受愈，反之则降低30%护甲与魔抗。

Sinbad studies the fighting styles of the "hitter" and the "guard" to strengthen the debuffs he applies. If the "hitter" deals more normal attack damage, Sinbad's debuff will reduce their ATK SPD by 60; if they deal more skill damage, the debuff will reduce their Energy Recovery efficiency by 60%.
For the "guard", if they depend more on healing from allies or themselves, Sinbad's debuff will reduce their Vitality by 60; if they rely more on damage mitigations, the debuff will reduce their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 30%.
若“侵略者”造成的伤害主要来源于其普通攻击，则辛巴达还会降低其80点攻击速度，反之则降低80%的回能效率。若“守护者”主要依靠友军或自身的治疗对抗敌人，则辛巴达会降低其80点受愈，反之则降低40%护甲与魔抗。

If the "hitter" deals more normal attack damage, Sinbad will reduce their ATK SPD by 80; if they deal more skill damage, he will reduce their Energy Recovery efficiency by 80%.
If the "guard" relies more on healing from allies or themselves, Sinbad will reduce their Vitality by 80; if they rely more on damage mitigations, he will reduce their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 40%.
若上次情报分析时的“侵略者”或“守护者”在下次情报分析时再次被对应标记为“侵略者”或“守护者”，则使“侵略者”的攻击力额外降低20%，使“守护者”受到的伤害额外提升10%。
If an enemy is marked as "hitter" or "guard" in two consecutive assessments, their ATK is further reduced by 20% if marked as "hitter", and they take 10% more damage if marked as "guard".
